title: rosa pendulina subvar. lagenaria
intro: Rosa pendulina subvar. lagenaria, commonly known as Rockrose or Lagenaria, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its ornamental value and medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, as well as promoting relaxation and calming effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits. Rosa pendulina subvar. lagenaria has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including insomnia, stress, and digestive problems.
